The wall bracket has a hinged arm allowing the dryer to swing away from the wall, seen fully extended in photos 2 and 3.
Surface shows normal cosmetic wear: scuff marks and light scratches on the white hood (photo 3) and on the black bracket arm.
No photos show the unit powered on, no close-up of the control dial/timer markings, no shot of the plug or socket, and no interior view of the heating element or hose.
